links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Ease) of chatbot answers to patient strabismus questions versus AAPOS website
links.effect: AAPOS was easiest to read (mean 55.8 ± 14.11), closely followed by Copilot; ChatGPT and Bard had lower readability scores.
links.quote: Flesch-Kincaid Ease Scores revealed the AAPOS as the easiest to read (mean score: 55.8 ± 14.11), closely followed by Copilot.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Bard, Copilot) compared to an educational website on answering real patient questions about strabismus using readability, understandability, and accuracy metrics without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
